name: io.github.partcad/partcad

environmentVariables.name: PC_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The PartCAD package to serve: a directory with a partcad.yaml, or the file. The working directory when unset.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: The PartCAD workspace to serve: the directory holding partcad.yaml, or a repository above it.

workspace.description: The absolute path of the workspace on this machine.

runtimeArguments.description: Serve the workspace mounted above, and write into it as the user who owns it.

runtimeArguments.name: --mount
runtimeArguments.description: Keep PartCAD's sandboxes and caches between runs. Without it every run builds a CAD sandbox from nothing, which takes minutes.
